name: Report overlapping appointments from Google Calendar by email

parameters.content:
# Report overlapping appointments from Google Calendar by email

## Who this is for

Businesses using one Google Calendar for a single person or bookable resource. If appointments arrive through several channels, a daily review can catch clashes that were added outside the booking form.

## How it works

The workflow reads upcoming timed events, expands recurring appointments and finds overlapping pairs. Appointments that meet exactly at their start and end times are compatible. Cancelled events, events marked free and invitations you declined are excluded.

When a clash or an invalid timed date needs attention, it emails one internal recipient a summary. It leaves appointments unchanged.

## Setup

1. Run the included example with `demo_mode` enabled. This uses fictional appointments and sends no email.
2. In **Configure calendar and report**, set the calendar, recipient, reporting timezone and review window.
3. Connect your Google Calendar and Gmail credentials. Switch `demo_mode` off and run a manual check.
4. Review the schedule and workflow timezone before publishing or activating it.

## Requirements and scope

Use n8n, Google Calendar and Gmail. Choose a calendar for one resource; intentional overlaps on a shared team calendar will also be reported. All-day events are excluded. The same unresolved clash can appear in the next daily report.

Created by [Webs del Camp](https://websdelcamp.cat/es/automatizaciones?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=calendar_audit_2026_10_03&utm_content=template_author), web and business automation services in Spain.

## Start here
Keep `demo_mode` true for the first manual run. The example produces one overlapping pair and sends no email.

Set one calendar and one internal recipient. The report timezone controls how dates appear. Review the workflow timezone and daily schedule before enabling live runs.

## Read-only calendar review
Connect Google Calendar only for live runs. Read all events in the selected window and expand recurring appointments. Use a calendar for one person or one resource.

The audit checks timed events only. It excludes all-day, cancelled, free and self-declined events. Back-to-back appointments do not overlap.

## Review the report
Connect Gmail for the live email. Only live reports with conflicts or invalid dates are sent. Open the Code or final result node to inspect demo output.

Emails contain appointment titles. Choose an authorized internal recipient. The workflow does not create, change, cancel or email attendees about appointments. Unresolved clashes can appear in later daily reports.
